_comment: Single source of truth for the practice's public identity, links and tracking IDs. tools/audit.py checks every page against this file; tools/build_worker.py reads the tracking block. Values marked "status": "needs_confirmation" must be confirmed by Dr. Bibin Baby before use. Never put passwords or API secrets here: this file is public.

proposed_platform_display_name.note: The brief uses 'Dr. Bibin Baby ENT'; the website uses 'Dr. Bibin Baby – ENT Consultation'. Pick one display name for Google Business Profile, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and WhatsApp and use it everywhere.

identity.registration: Registration number 66908, Kerala State Medical Council (KSMC)

locations.name: Dr. Bibin Baby – ENT Consultation, Pala

google_review_url.note: Google Business Profile > Ask for reviews > copy the link (looks like https://g.page/r/.../review).

google_business_profile_url.note: Hospital-owned listing; the doctor may instead have a practitioner listing at this address.

youtube.note: No YouTube channel is linked anywhere on the site. Supply the channel URL (preferably the @handle form) if one exists.

appointment_booking.method: WhatsApp request form on the home page (#appointment); phone call

external_platform_url.note: If Practo, Eka Care, a hospital booking page or similar is used, supply the link.

healthcare_directories.note: List any Practo, Justdial, Lybrate, Sunrise Hospital doctor-profile or other directory listings so that their details can be checked for consistency.

tracking._cloudflare_note: Leave null. Cloudflare Web Analytics (site token b98a6f237964447d9057a5c3e5a19ef3, cookieless) is injected automatically by Cloudflare into pages served to browsers. Setting the token here as well would add a second beacon and count every visit twice. Set it only if automatic injection is switched off in Cloudflare.
tracking._ga4_note: Set to the G-XXXXXXXXXX ID once a GA4 property exists. GA4 sets cookies: add a consent notice and update /privacy/ before enabling.
tracking._gsc_note: Prefer verifying Search Console with a DNS TXT record (Domain property). Use this meta-tag value only if DNS verification is not possible.
